review_scope: Complete infrastructure change in two identical PRs; not a partial product-spec review or final application gate.
risk_justification: Publication triggers, credentials, preview input trust, OIDC/Pages permissions and environment branch authorization.

coverage.requirements: User decision recorded in docs/pages-stable.md confronted with complete seven-file diff; stable preserves static site, main has no Pages publication, previews retained.
coverage.architecture: No backend or business persistence changes; explicit publisher/material/production sources and trusted stable tools preserve local/CI/Docker build consumers.
coverage.integration: Both PRs share exact base/head; complete diff and both corrective deltas examined. Final application integration remains separately gated after new main/base/head.
coverage.security: Stable-only workflow ref, denied main/pages-store input, no persisted checkout credentials, scoped gh helper, trusted tools and lstat validation of public/stored preview inputs examined.
coverage.persistence: pages-store archives and serial publication preserved; no business DB/schema/data changes.
coverage.tests: Eleven regressions read, including legacy material and harmless outside sentinels/FIFO; reviewer executed none. Windows six passed/five platform skips, Linux all eleven passed.
coverage.maintenance: README/AGENTS/runbook aligned to stable, static source unchanged, original main commit preserved, public URL/previews preserved by design.

limitations: Reviewer used read-only code/commit/diff/hash queries; no tests/build/scripts/network/DB/publication/writes/delegation.
Remote Pages/environment configuration, helper operation and deployments not verified by reviewer; coordinator will execute and record those separately.
Filesystem validation assumes stable checkouts during assembly; no guarantee against another local process racing filesystem changes.

All quota windows unavailable before/after every phase, token categories unavailable, no isolation/consumption attribution. Coordinator operational updates occurred during waiting; initial after observation includes coordinator triage delay.
